features.calendar: Complete market calendar; missing factors explicit 0+mask, no synthetic quotes/returns; seasoned resumed stocks remain predictable
features.adjustment: Actual daily adj_factor; no future month-end interpolation
features.stage_labels: Past-only weak context: breakout, reversal, continuation, range
features.universe: All supplied SH/SZ boards including ChiNext and STAR; buy restriction is execution-only
features.scaling: Fixed clipping bounds here; train-only standardization in model
features.theme_selection: Strongest self-free peer return20 - .02*log(observed theme size); at least five feature-valid stocks; no named theme gate
features.theme_unknown: Zero context plus known_theme_context=0; stocks are not excluded
features.theme_causality: Latest whole historically available snapshot; current completed features only; no target in selection
features.amount_role: Raw same-session traded amount relative to selected theme average, not a market-cap proxy

checkpoint_format: Pickled LightGBM boosters; .pt is artifact name only

path_target_protocol.entry: Actual factor-adjusted open at market session t+1
path_target_protocol.stop: Close <= entry*(1-.08); trigger at close, exit at next market-session actual open
path_target_protocol.trailing: Peak starts at entry and uses subsequent closes only; activate at +20%, trigger at 8% retreat from that peak
path_target_protocol.horizon_exit: If no earlier trigger, exit at actual open t+h+1; a trigger on close t+h retains its stop reason
path_target_protocol.stop_priority: First trigger wins; if hard and trailing trigger together, hard stop takes priority
path_target_protocol.downside: max(0, 1-min(entry open, intraday lows through last held close, exit open)/entry); exclude all exit-day intraday lows
path_target_protocol.first_passage: First close at upper gain (.10,.15,.30) or at -8% during t+1...t+h, independently of any earlier trailing exit; otherwise neither
path_target_protocol.passage_ties: Inclusive boundaries; positive upper and negative lower are disjoint, so a close cannot hit both; earliest session wins
path_target_protocol.complete_window: Require every actual OHLC/factor quote from t+1 through t+h+1, including after an early reference exit; no fill or compressed calendar
path_target_protocol.label_maturity: Always market session t+h+1, not early exit date; training requires label_end strictly before cutoff
path_target_protocol.missing_labels: NaN payoff/downside, -1 passage/reason/indices, valid=False; label_end remains calendar-based when that session exists
path_target_protocol.quote_presence: Actual supplied OHLC and adjustment-factor quote; this label-only flag never changes feature eligibility
path_target_protocol.adjustment: Raw OHLC times actual same-day adj_factor; no future-normalised qfq series
path_target_protocol.execution_scope: Reference label omits official future locked-limit execution, fees and model-switch exits; exact account execution remains separate

original_feature_store: Unchanged V3 source artifact, including its unused original future labels
factor_inputs: Unchanged finite/masked V3 daily tree factors
heads: Three native path-payoff, three held-period MAE and three first-passage 3-class trees
validation: Twenty past eligible sessions; both train and validation purged using t+h+1 label maturity
hyperparameters_selected_from: Single fixed path-target hypothesis after native-close and residual failures; no sweep
evaluation_status: Previously inspected 2026 research history, not an untouched holdout
diagnostics: Use path_targets.pkl for forecast errors; generic original feature-store forward-return quality is not this target

buy_filter.hypothesis: Fixed current signal-day all-market amount percentile >= .95
buy_filter.purpose: Research stock leadership/liquidity selection; not a capital-capacity necessity
buy_filter.inputs: V3 frozen amount_percentile, explicit availability and current feature eligibility only
buy_filter.order: Current known amount gate, then positive native utility and mainboard top 40, then exact signal-day official band >= .075
buy_filter.precision: Threshold represented in the stored factor dtype; no decimal rounding of percentiles
buy_filter.retained_positions: Unchanged; eligibility controls new purchases, never a forced-sale rule
buy_filter.predictions: All source rows and all native forecast columns retained without changes
